name: FontAlternatives · Alegreya

title.zh: FontAlternatives · 比较字体替代线索

description.zh: 用同一句文字观察字形，再到原字体来源核许可。 按字体名称、类别与替代关系组织的字体参考目录，提供字形预览、比较入口与原字体来源链接。替代关系、相似度和许可标注是平台资料；本次未核实全部字体包许可、平台软件许可或预览输出授权。
description.en: A typeface reference directory organized by names, categories, and alternative relationships, with specimen previews, comparison links, and original font sources. Alternative relationships, similarity scores, and license labels are platform information. This visit has not verified licenses for every font package, the platform software, or exported previews.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by FontAlternatives (https://fontalternatives.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 用同一句文字观察字形，再到原字体来源核许可。

Visual details from source observation: 我们从首页的字体检索进入 Alegreya，先看到一段完整衬线字样，字号、字重和对齐控件就在样张上方，便于把要用的短句放进同一舞台比较。建议先观察字形的粗细变化与字距，再循详情里的 Google Fonts 来源核对字体文件和许可。这里的替代关系与相似度是平台参考，不能当成原字厂结论；页面的 OFL 标注也不覆盖网站软件或预览输出。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
